title: AICP Onboarding State
description: Represents the current state of an agent-service onboarding session as it progresses through protocol phases.

session_id.description: Unique identifier for this onboarding session.

agent_did.description: DID of the agent being onboarded.

service_did.description: DID of the service performing the onboarding.

started_at.description: Timestamp when the onboarding session was initiated.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent state transition.

expires_at.description: Timestamp when this onboarding session expires if not completed.

failed_reason.description: Human-readable explanation when the session enters the 'failed' phase.

OnboardingPhase.description: The current phase of the onboarding lifecycle.
